identity_rules: Each physical period section has one identity and one current location; no section occupies two panel slots
Panel membership is nine distinct sections with eleven ordered design slots each; repeated design labels do not imply one shared physical cell
Build jobs link source lot, qualified geometry/process revisions, safe release and extracted physical parts
Panel repair/replacement creates an assembly revision; removal/reinstallation creates a new install epoch
Four acquisitions share one position/specimen and cannot be counted as four independent samples
Independent fabricated sample count remains unresolved until the allocation card supplies it
Raw records are append-only, content-addressed references; errors and retries never overwrite prior records
Calibration belongs to device/channel/phase reference and an explicit valid interval; panel swaps do not alter old data
destruction: No source-reported destructive test; failed extraction or damage removes the item from valid reuse until requalified or replaced
raw_schema_note: Canonical keys are shared with tests/contract_checks.py; timestamps include timezone, units are explicit, and condition carries the listed signature keys.
